blocks.text: Your after-hours building access is set up, so you should be able to get in on the weekends we run late during valuation season. Two things are worth noting:

items: The building office issued the badge under your full name, Michelle Banks, so if the reader at the garage entrance rejects it, that mismatch is the first thing to check.
It covers the elevator to our floor and the side entrance after six, but not the loading dock; for anything through the dock you still need to call down to the front desk.

blocks.text: Let me know if the badge does not work and I will take it up with building management.
